prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified. TWO rows TWO columns. TOP OURAN adult male record-box keeper and father, mature man with greying brown short hair and beard, weathered grey hooded wool mantle over earth-brown tunic, hands empty, guarded stooped stance; no burning torch or lit fire, no papers exposed, not sole owner of every archive key. BOTTOM WEIYU adult woman fragment-page scribe, dark wavy hair in low bun, muted teal wool dress with brown shoulder wrap, small closed blank writing folio tucked under arm, belt pen case closed, composed questioning stance. No restoration of lost originals, public personal addresses, completed correction, burning or absolution.
